newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bureaucrats start strike over pay.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bureaucrats start strike over pay.

text.p: About 1.3 million Venezuelan civil servants began a 48-hour strike on Tuesday to demand overdue wage bonuses, union officials said.
The strike was the most serious labour conflict since President Rafael Caldera took office in February 1994.
"The strike has been a complete success...workers are at the doors of their offices," Antonio Suarez, head of the Public Sector Workers Federation, said.
Suarez said the government owed staff, who earn an average monthly wage equivalent to $106, a total of 71 billion bolivars ($150 million) in bonuses promised in February.
"If they don't pay what we are owed we will continue the protest," he added.
Government officials have pledged to honour the bonuses as soon as Congress approves the funds.
Doctors and university professors have threatened to join the strike to demand raises. Annual inflation in Venezuela is running at over 100 percent.
